title: Hero Definition
description: Single source of truth for the hero: name, stats, starter deck, and overworld sprite. The compiler emits src/game/hero_content.c (bank-2 starter-deck table) from this file.

name.description: Display name shown in battle UI (e.g., 'Hero').

start_hp.description: Starting HP (also max HP at game start).

starter_deck.description: Ordered starter deck (exact draw-pile order). Each entry must be a valid CARD_* constant from game_ids.h (quest-only SPECIAL cards are rejected at compile time). Max 20 cards. Compiled into g_hero_starter_deck by battle_compile.py; both game_new_game and the battle fallback read it.

items.description: Tile name from tools/compose_hero_sprites.py LAYOUT (1-2 frames).

anyOf.description: OBJ ramp name from assets/palette.txt (preferred; the editor writes names).

palette.description: CGB OAM palette: an OBJ ramp name (preferred) or a legacy hardware slot index.
